svg.title: Campus Cards · Set 01 · Santa Barbara · 02/12 Campus Point (Rare)
svg.desc: The bluff tip where the campus meets the channel. Surf check, then class. Unofficial. An independent PointCast art project about places. Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the University of California or any campus. No university logos, seals, mascots, or marks are used.
